title: Zachary and Baton Rouge geography
summary: Pete says he left Zachary for Baton Rouge in 1928 and describes the station stops.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Are you originally from around, I mean, did you live around Baton Rouge much?

Oh, yes. I've been moved away from Zachary, Louisiana since 28. And I've been around, let's say, Baton Rouge ever since. Yes. I was born and raised there in Zachary, but we left there in 28 and we've been living there in Baton Rouge.
Well, I would say that Zachary's, that's the fourth wall. Fourth, that's the fourth wall. Because Baton Rouge is third. Zachary would be fourth. It's north of Baton Rouge. Yes. North of Baton Rouge.
I have to look it up on the map.
No, I'm not originally from Louisiana.

Well, the other one, it ain't too far from here. Zachary, not too far from here. You got, I would count as one, two, three, four, five. Five stops. Mm-hmm. Little, little, little station before you hit Baton Rouge. That's Zachary, Elther, Slaughter. Baker. Baker. Scholar, Scholarville. That's five stops before you hit Baton Rouge.
